variant: Liebherr Remote Control System for crawler dozers, crawler excavators and tower cranes
name: Liebherr LiReCon remote control system
summary: Teleoperation system from Liebherr: an operator stand with cameras and microphones lets a driver run Liebherr crawler dozers, crawler excavators and tower cranes from a safe distance, without seeing the machine. First delivered on two PR 726 G8 dozers to the Austrian Armed Forces in 2024 and shown live at bauma 2025.

germany.statusNote: Liebherr builds and sells LiReCon itself: the Telfs (Austria) dozer plant's sales manager presents it as a solution for all crawler dozer operations and Liebherr calls it a universal cross-sector product for different Liebherr machines. No price list or German product page was found; ask Liebherr sales. Deliveries so far: two PR 726 G8 dozers for the Austrian Armed Forces (2024); bauma 2025 demo with an excavator, a dozer and a tower crane near Biberach.

sellers.name: Liebherr-Werk Telfs GmbH
sellers.note: Crawler dozer plant; its sales manager is quoted on LiReCon. Contact request form on the press page. Price on request.

sellers.name: Liebherr-Werk Biberach GmbH
sellers.note: Memminger Straße 120, 88400 Biberach an der Riß. Tower crane plant that ran the bauma 2025 tower crane demo; phone is the marketing contact on the press release.

specs.label: Machines
specs.value: Liebherr crawler excavators, crawler dozers and tower cranes
specs.conditions: machines named in the bauma 2025 demo
specs.quote: The earthmoving and tower crane product segments will be demonstrating the practical application of this technology using a crawler excavator, a crawler dozer and a tower crane.

specs.label: Operator station
specs.value: teleoperation stand with several real-time cameras and microphones
specs.quote: The LiReCon system consists of a state-of-the-art teleoperation stand equipped with the latest control technology. Several cameras provide real-time images from different perspectives, while microphones transmit the machine sounds.

specs.label: Link to the machine
specs.value: radio; works without visual contact; relay stations optional for longer range
specs.quote: The on-site solution enables remote control of machines without visual contact, while relay stations are available as an option for extended operational range.

specs.label: Longest demo distance
specs.conditions: 240 EC-B Fibre tower crane near Biberach controlled from the bauma stand in Munich
specs.quote: The crane, a 240 EC-B Fibre with an innovative fibre rope, is just under 200 kilometres away from the Messe München site

specs.label: Safety functions
specs.value: integrated emergency stop; encrypted data transmission; operator certification with authorisation levels
specs.quote: the system has an integrated emergency stop control to stop the machine dead in dangerous situations

specs.label: Demo excavator
specs.value: R 926 G8, 150 kW, 28 t, with Leica machine control
specs.quote: The R 926 G8, which is manufactured at the Colmar plant in France, impresses with an output of 150 kW / 204 hp and an operating weight of 28 tonnes.

notes: Remote control system, not autonomy: a human drives the machine from the stand or a container.
Capabilities describe the tracked host machines (crawler excavator or dozer); a tower crane can also be fitted.
Liebherr calls LiReCon a foundation for future machine automation.
